description: NLWeb-style natural-language query over Remote Vegas. Use it for open questions that don't map cleanly to filters (e.g. "somewhere with a view to work on a Sunday morning"). Returns schema.org places (CafeOrCoffeeShop, Library, Hotel…) with reasons and URLs to cite; mode "summarize" adds a one-line summary.
name: ask
title: Ask Remote Vegas a free-form question
